name: Please Be Quiet Evanston 2023
information:
We are excited to host the first ever PBQ competition in Illlinois! While new competitors are welcome, please note that this competition focuses on blindfolded events, so 3x3 and other beginner-friendly events will not be held.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://midwestcubing.org).
